reports.title: U.S. GAAP Quarterly Report for the Period Ended September 30, 2026

lines: At September 30, 2026, there was $53.2 million remaining in unrecognized compensation cost net of estimated forfeitures related to these awards, which is expected to be recognized over a weighted-average period of 1.37 years.

Total costs, including impairments, consulting and advisory costs, are estimated to be approximately $75.0 million, of which approximately $12.0 million is expected to be incurred during the remainder of 2026.
